text:
lee: FYI apiserver 503s just popped up in eu-central. I'm seeing a pattern: short-lived tcp resets and a slow decline in available conntrack slots.

nora: saw that too, k8s-event-exporter shows controller-manager backoff floods. metrics: conntrack_inuse ~ 240k on nodes with nf_conntrack_max=262144.

devops-bot: [alert] eu-central conntrack_utilization=91% threshold breached; ticket OPEN-2026-045 created.

pat: any recent network agent changes? We rolled a Cilium minor last night but thought it was fine.

lee: Cilium 1.12.3 rolled 22h ago. No kube-proxy or kernel updates since Monday.

zara: `ss -s` output shows many TIME-WAIT/FIN_WAIT sockets, but also a cluster of ESTABLISHED entries tied to 10.2.0.0/16 -> 10.3.0.0/16 cross-node flows.

hector: suspected NAT helper leak. cilium-agent logs show repeated "conntrack helper removed" and then refcounts not decreasing: snippet: 
```
level=info msg="nat helper cleanup failed" helper=ftp refcnt=5
level=warn msg="conntrack garbage collect skipped" region=euc1
```

pat: that explains slow freeing of conntrack slots. When helpers hang, nf_conntrack doesn't decrement.

lee: immediate mitigation: I recommend bumping nf_conntrack_max to 524288 on eu-central nodes, and temporarily disable aggressive GPU onboarding so we don't saturate control plane with new pods.

nora: +1. I'll throttle onboarding with a short feature-flag: `kubectl patch config onboarding -p '{"spec":{"rateLimit":10}}'` (will scope to eu-central).

devops-bot: executed throttle patch for onboarding (region=euc1) by nora.

hector: also lowering kube-proxy conntrack tcp_timeout_close_wait and conntrack_min settings on canary nodes might help; suggest canary on 4 nodes first. config: `--conntrack-max-per-core=32768 --conntrack-ttl=120s`

zara: note: changing kube-proxy flags will cause a restart of those pods. We should only do 4 at a time to avoid controlplane pressure.

pat: I'm starting gradual nf_conntrack bump now: `for node in $(kubectl get nodes -l region=euc1 -o name); do ssh $node sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288; done` 

lee: after bump, apiserver 503 rate decreased by ~70% and conntrack inuse dropped to ~150k over 6 minutes. controller-manager backoff events down as well.

nora: created a short canary plan: 4 kube-proxy nodes -> monitor conntrack delta 15m -> if stable, roll 8 more -> then Cilium NAT patch. Documented at /playbooks/network/conntrack-canary.md (internal).

hector: long-term: schedule kernel upgrade to include nf_conntrack fixes, and coordinate with Cilium team for a release that addresses helper refcount regression.

pat: cost note: failed GPU onboarding caused ~12 GPU-hours wasted due to retries. tagging cost to SRE-costs for chargeback.

zara: opening postmortem ticket SRE-4220, assigning lee and hector as leads. will include conntrack dumps, cilium logs, and timeline.

lee: once Cilium patch validated, we should add a guard: node-level conntrack autoscaling + alerting sooner (e.g., 70% warn, 85% critical) and an automated temporary throttle on onboarding.

nora: agreed. also add a kube-proxy conntrack tuning template to infra repo so we can apply region-scoped canaries faster next time.

devops-bot: incident OPEN-2026-045 transitioned to monitoring.

pat: will unpause onboarding in 25m if no regressions. thanks all. :thumbsup:
